srList.sentence: Definition of MS MS was defined as the presence of a cluster of >= 3 of the following: 1 ) abdominal obesity ( waist circumference >= 90 cm for men and >= 85 cm for women ) 2 ) elevated blood pressure ( average systolic blood pressure >= 130 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure >= 85 mmHg ) 3 ) low HDL-cholesterol level ( < 40 mgdL for men and < 50 mgdL for women ) 4 ) elevated serum triglyceride level ( >= 150 mgdL ) and 5 ) elevated fasting blood glucose level ( >= 110 mgdL).
